_comment: Simple Mods Pro - one account subscription on account.simplemods.de (N108). Placeholders until the owner decides prices/perks (A page 'Pro'). price_month null = the price of the mapped Simple Livemap tier in tiers.json; yearly = tiers.json yearly_months_paid x monthly. The server config may override single values under "plans" (and "perks"). Owner 19.11. (N109 P001): plans Basic/Max/Ultra (old plan id "pro" = max, accepted on read). P039: fellow-player seats ('lite') per plan, fixed count, end with the owner's subscription, no chaining, a freed seat can be given again after lite_rules.reassign_lock_days. Part 2: flags P050 vote_weight (Basic 1/Max 2/Ultra 3), P053 credits and P079 wiki_settings from Basic (themes for all = no flag); gifts P068 (months, names per plan, change_days).
